findings.current: That was why neither a Supreme Peak master nor an S-rank Hunter could approach me in pure physical ability.
findings.defect: The English omits that the System enhanced the narrator’s physical abilities to a superhuman level, the stated reason for the comparison.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly identifies System-based growth and describes the resulting physical ability as superhuman before drawing the comparison.
findings.replacement: The System had made my physical abilities superhuman in the truest sense of the word. That was why neither a Supreme Peak master nor an S-rank Hunter could approach me in pure physical ability.

summary: One factual error changes which Monster Wave the reporter asks about; the English also omits two source details.
